description: This file defines the WorkWeekAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for retrieving and updating work week configurations within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It includes methods for fetching work week data, updating specific day settings, and handling input validation. The class uses traits and models specific to the leave module and is part of the API layer for managing work week schedules.

classes.name: WorkWeekAPI
classes.description: Provides API endpoints for managing work week data, allowing retrieval and updates of work schedule configurations within the leave module.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific WorkWeek record by ID and returns it in the specified model format.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines and returns the model class to use based on the request parameter.

methods.name: getModelParamRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for the 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: getIdFromUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts and returns the WorkWeek record ID from URL attributes.

methods.name: getIdParamRule
methods.description: Validation rule ensuring the ID parameter is positive.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' method, requiring ID and optional model parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a WorkWeek record with provided day values and returns the updated object.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating, including validation for each day parameter.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented. Throws an exception if called.

methods.description: Not implemented. Throws an exception if called.
